categories.main_business_segments: China Catalyst Holding Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of specialty molecular sieves and catalytic new materials, along with chemical technology and process services. Its main product categories include specialty molecular sieves and catalysts, non-molecular sieve catalysts, and catalytic application processes and chemical technology services. These products serve industries such as environmental protection, energy chemical, and fine chemicals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced synthesis and production technologies for molecular sieves including CHA, TS-1, ZSM-35, ZSM-5, Y, and β molecular sieves. It has proprietary technologies for catalyst preparation, including metal oxide and metal catalysts like iron-molybdenum, nickel-copper, and phthalic anhydride catalysts. Production processes involve crystallization, distillation, drying, calcination, ion exchange, mixing, molding, and shaping. The company also develops chemical synthesis process packages such as HPPO for propylene oxide production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major international chemical companies such as BASF, and domestic large-scale chemical manufacturers. The products are used in automotive exhaust treatment, petrochemical refining, coal chemical, fine chemical production, and environmental protection sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets including Asia-Pacific, Europe, North America, and South Africa.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Dalian, Liaoning Province, and has sales networks covering Asia-Pacific, Europe, North America, and South Africa. It exports products to international markets and maintains strategic partnerships with global chemical enterprises.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Catalyst operates mainly in the midstream segment of the chemical supply chain, focusing on the production of specialty molecular sieves and catalysts that serve as critical materials for downstream chemical manufacturing and environmental applications. It also provides chemical process technology services supporting downstream production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in specialty molecular sieves and catalytic materials, focusing on environmentally friendly and energy-saving technologies. R&D priorities include developing advanced denitrification molecular sieves, metal catalysts, and high-purity silicon and aluminum oxide materials. It invests heavily in R&D, maintaining a high ratio of R&D expenses to revenue, and collaborates with leading research institutes and customers to enhance product performance and expand applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of specialty molecular sieves, catalysts, and related chemical technology services. The company also earns income from licensing chemical process technology packages. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels to large industrial customers under framework agreements and order-based contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: China Catalyst is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer in the specialty molecular sieve and catalyst industry, competing with international chemical giants like BASF. It has achieved significant market share in mobile source denitrification molecular sieves and has developed products that substitute imported catalysts in key chemical processes. The company is recognized as a national intellectual property demonstration enterprise and a specialized 'little giant' in the industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 549.9 million, a 19.21% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 76.9 million, down 49.34%. Despite revenue decline due to market demand reduction, cash flow from operations doubled compared to the prior year. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 2.9 billion and net assets of RMB 2.6 billion, with ongoing investments in capacity expansion projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: China Catalyst offers high-performance, environmentally friendly specialty molecular sieves and catalysts with proprietary technologies that improve catalytic efficiency, product yield, and environmental compliance. Its products meet stringent emission standards such as China VI and are recognized for stable quality and cost advantages. The company provides integrated chemical process solutions, enhancing customer production efficiency and enabling import substitution in critical chemical sectors.
